name: wa-reader
description: Read-only access to your WhatsApp Web through the WA Reader Chrome extension: recent messages, unread and awaiting-reply chats, one chat, and search.
long_description: WA Reader lets Claude read your WhatsApp on demand. It works together with the free WA Reader Chrome extension: keep web.whatsapp.com open in Chrome, and Claude can read recent messages, see which chats are unread or waiting for your reply, read one chat, or search. It cannot send, delete or mark messages. Nothing is stored, and messages travel only inside your computer (127.0.0.1) to Claude. Paste the token from the extension's settings when installing.

token.title: WA Reader token
token.description: Copy it from the WA Reader Chrome extension: Settings → Claude Desktop → Copy token.

port.title: Local port
port.description: Leave as is unless you changed the port in the extension settings.
